ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; the visible surface is approximately 95% low-intensity (dark grey/black) with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to discrete, small-scale features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the primary surface area with isolated, high-contrast white circular spots (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) scattered across both lobes; no large contiguous white geometric regions are present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge topography characterized by high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitude variations up to 40 pixels, particularly on the inner margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve on the lateral margins sweeping upward and outward toward pointed, vertically-oriented tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial clusters of high-contrast white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) on the distal tips of both lobes; multiple isolated circular high-contrast rings (scars) distributed across the mid-ventral dark surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, low-contrast circular and short non-aligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the dark background; no prominent, high-contrast linear rake marks detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization on the distal peripheral edges; significant irregular serration and chipping along the trailing edge consistent with accumulated physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of protruding barnacles specifically on the extreme upper-most margins of the fluke lobes.
